title: Writer-token allocation test records on its workers and asserts after join

installed_sdk.rationale: No installed header, target, or exported symbol changes. The edit is confined to a Catch2 test translation unit that ships in no SDK artifact.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No CLI verb, flag, or handler is added or changed. The test drives WriterToken directly and is never invoked as a shipped command.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition or handler is added or changed. Nothing under tools/mcp reads or registers this test.

live_product_control.rationale: No capability, operation, executor binding, or profile policy changes. Concurrent command-id allocation behaviour is unchanged; only where the test asserts moved.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: docs/status/agent-capabilities.json is unchanged. Relocating a test assertion off a worker thread publishes no design-time capability.
